class="group min-w-0 text-4xl font-medium leading-tight mb-8 text-foreground" id="idle-time-tasks">闲时任务<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h1>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">不是所有任务都需要马上开始。整理一份代码库分析、批量补一轮注释、跑一遍文档同步检查——这类工作晚几个小时拿到结果并不影响什么。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">闲时任务</strong> 就是为这种场景准备的：你提交任务后它进入全局队列，等到算力富余时段自动执行，<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">过程免费，不消耗你的订阅套餐额度</strong>。</p>
<blockquote class="border-l-4 border-border bg-muted/5 px-4 py-2 italic text-muted-foreground mb-4">
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">逐步开放中。</strong> 闲时任务目前面向订阅用户分批开放，你的客户端里可能暂时看不到相关入口。功能全量开放后本说明会移除。</p>
</blockquote>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">和 <a class="text-primary underline decoration-primary/80 transition-colors hover:decoration-primary" href="/cn/docs/automations">定时任务</a> 的区别很清楚：定时任务由你指定时间、可以反复执行；闲时任务不排时间表、只跑一次，什么时候开始由队列决定。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="prerequisites">使用前提<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">闲时任务需要有效的 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">Coding Plan 订阅</strong>。ZAI 与 BigModel 的<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">个人版</strong> Coding Plan 都可以使用；Start Plan 和纯 API Key 模式不支持。<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">团队套餐</strong>的支持正在开放中，当前选中团队套餐连接时可能无法创建，请暂时切换到个人套餐。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">如果你还没有订阅，点击闲时任务入口时会提示升级；如果订阅正常但没有选中对应的模型连接，提交按钮会保持禁用并给出提示——先在 <a class="text-primary underline decoration-primary/80 transition-colors hover:decoration-primary" href="/cn/docs/configuration">连接模型</a> 里选好连接即可。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">如果界面提示「暂时无法确认创建资格，请刷新后重试」，说明资格校验请求还在进行中或暂时失败（例如网络波动），<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">不代表你的账号没有资格</strong>——刷新页面或稍后再试即可。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="create">创建闲时任务<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">在左侧边栏点击 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">自动化</strong>，切到 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">闲时任务</strong> 标签，点击 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">创建闲时任务</strong>。也可以在新建任务首页直接使用闲时任务模板，点击后会预填好指令带你进入创建页。</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/20260730-core-features/workbench/clean-sidebar-overview-annotated.png" alt="新建任务首页的闲时任务入口：订阅用户提示横幅与可直接套用的任务模板" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">表单需要填写：</p>
<div class="mb-6 overflow-x-auto rounded-md border border-border bg-card"><table class="min-w-full border-collapse text-sm"><thead class="bg-muted/60 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-muted-foreground"><tr class="bg-transparent"><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">字段</th><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">说明</th></tr></thead><tbody class="bg-card"><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">任务标题</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">默认为「Untitled」，建议改成能一眼认出的名字</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">指令</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">任务的全部内容。因为是无人值守执行，指令要尽量完整、自足</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">项目</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">只能选当前窗口已打开的本地项目，<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">创建后不可修改</strong></td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">权限</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">和会话一样的<a class="text-primary underline decoration-primary/80 transition-colors hover:decoration-primary" href="/cn/docs/agents#modes">四档执行模式</a>，默认「变更前确认」</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">模型 / 推理强度</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">从闲时任务可用的模型列表中选择</td></tr></tbody></table></div>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/20260730-core-features/idle-tasks/idle-task-create-form.webp" alt="闲时任务创建表单：以「发布候选版本回归风险分析」为例，指令写清了分析范围、输出格式与验证方式，底部依次选好项目、权限、模型与推理强度" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">指令写得越完整，无人值守时跑出来的结果越接近预期——上图的例子把要分析什么、输出成什么格式、怎么验证都交代清楚了，可以作为参考。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">因为任务在你不盯着的时候执行，<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">建议先提交一次 Git commit</strong> 再创建任务，这样对结果不满意时可以干净地回退。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="queue">排队与执行<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">提交后任务进入 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">全局队列</strong>，按创建时间先来先到排，任务卡片上会显示当前排到第几位。</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/20260730-core-features/idle-tasks/idle-task-queued-duo.webp" alt="左：提交后任务卡显示「排队第 1 位」；右：点开详情可随时核对项目、权限、模型与推理强度" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">排队期间不用干等：点开任务能核对刚才填的配置，发现写漏了直接改；列表下方的模板也一直可用，随手再排一个进去。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">轮到你的任务时它自动开始执行，状态变为「执行中」。整个过程有几个特点：</p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">无需你在场</strong>：任务在后台跑，你可以继续做别的事，甚至关掉这个项目的会话。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">长任务接着跑</strong>：单次执行有时长上限，到点后任务会回到队列，下次 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">接着原来的会话继续</strong>，不会从头再来。应用重启也不会丢。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">不承诺具体时间</strong>：队列取决于整体算力余量，界面不会给出「预计几点开始」这类估算。任务会一直等下去，直到轮到它——如果不想再等，取消即可。</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">执行期间如果 Agent 遇到需要确认的操作，会像普通会话一样在会话里等你响应，任务状态保持「执行中」。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="billing">免费范围与计费边界<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">免费覆盖整个自动执行过程</strong>：任务自动执行期间的每一次模型请求——包括工具调用循环、自动上下文压缩、以及前台派发的<a class="text-primary underline decoration-primary/80 transition-colors hover:decoration-primary" href="/cn/docs/subagents">子智能体</a>——都走闲时专用通道，不消耗你的套餐额度。长任务分段续跑时，每个续跑段同样免费。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">你主动发的消息不免费</strong>：任务执行中或执行后，你在同一会话里补充的任何消息（包括「继续」「立即处理」这类催促），都会按你当前选择的模型正常计入套餐额度。免费额度只覆盖闲时队列自动派发的执行，不覆盖你自己发出的消息——这是设计行为。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">插话和打断不是一回事，计费也不一样。</strong> 闲时任务的会话没有锁定，执行期间你可以照常输入，但两种做法的后果不同：</p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">不打断、直接输入</strong>：消息进入会话队列，等当前这一轮自动执行跑完才真正发出。这条消息以及它驱动的这一轮执行，按你当前选择的模型计入套餐额度；闲时任务本身不受影响，如果它还需要续跑，后面的自动分段照旧免费。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">按 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">Esc</code> 打断</strong>：当前这一轮自动执行被你收掉，闲时任务随之进入终态，<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">不会再回队列自动续跑</strong>。之后你在这个会话里继续做的一切都是普通付费对话——这就是「自己接管」，用的是你自己的模型和套餐额度。</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">权限确认不算接管</strong>：无人值守期间弹出的操作确认，你点批准或拒绝都仍在这一轮自动执行之内，继续走闲时免费通道，不会因为「是人点的」就变成付费。</p>
<blockquote class="border-l-4 border-border bg-muted/5 px-4 py-2 italic text-muted-foreground mb-4">
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">提示</strong>：只想看任务进行到哪一步，直接点开会话查看即可，纯查看不产生消耗。确实需要改要求时，把新要求写成一个新的闲时任务重新排队，比打断当前任务更划算；具体消耗可以在<a class="text-primary underline decoration-primary/80 transition-colors hover:decoration-primary" href="/cn/docs/usage-stats">使用统计</a>里核对。</p>
</blockquote>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">执行期间，会话界面始终显示你自己配置的模型；闲时通道实际使用的执行模型由服务端统一指定，不影响你的模型设置，执行结束后一切照旧。如果你在日志里看到模型被临时切换的记录，属于正常机制。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">两条与子智能体相关的限制：</p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">闲时任务执行中可以正常使用<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">前台</strong>子智能体（同样免费）。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">不支持后台子智能体</strong>。Agent 尝试后台派发会收到明确报错；如果你的自定义子智能体配置了后台执行（<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">background: true</code>），在闲时任务里会调用失败。</li>
</ul>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="manage">管理任务<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">任务有六种状态：<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">排队中、已暂停、执行中、已完成、失败、已取消</strong>。卡片右上角的菜单随状态变化：</p>
<div class="mb-6 overflow-x-auto rounded-md border border-border bg-card"><table class="min-w-full border-collapse text-sm"><thead class="bg-muted/60 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-muted-foreground"><tr class="bg-transparent"><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">当前状态</th><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">可用操作</th></tr></thead><tbody class="bg-card"><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">排队中</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">暂停、删除</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">已暂停</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">继续、删除</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">执行中</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">取消</td></tr></tbody></table></div>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">暂停会保留任务但停止派发。需要注意：<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">暂停太久的任务会被放回队列重新排队</strong>，位次可能因此往后。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">任务失败后不会自动重试，你可以检查指令和配置后重新提交一个新任务。已经完成的文件修改在任何情况下都不会自动回滚。</p>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="sidebar">在侧栏查看<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">已经开始执行过的闲时任务，会在左侧边栏的 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">闲时任务</strong> 分组里出现一行，行尾带月亮标识。点击可以进入对应会话查看 Agent 做了什么。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">还在排队和已暂停的任务不会出现在侧栏，它们只在自动化页面管理。</p>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="history">运行历史<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">任务详情页可以在 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">设置 / 历史</strong> 之间切换。因为闲时任务只跑一次，历史里最多一条记录，显示执行结果并支持跳转到对应会话。</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/20260801-automations/idle-run-history-annotated.webp" alt="闲时任务运行历史：只有一条执行成功的记录，行末菜单里可以打开当次会话" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="limits">需要注意的限制<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">电脑需要保持唤醒。</strong> 与定时任务一样，闲时任务在你的电脑上执行。机器睡眠期间不会推进，但也不会因此丢失——恢复后继续排队。如果希望它在夜间跑完，请打开自动化页面的 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">保持唤醒</strong> 开关。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">每天能创建的数量有上限。</strong> 额度用完后创建按钮会置灰，鼠标悬停能看到多久之后恢复，到点自动放开。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">只支持桌面端本地项目。</strong> 当前版本不支持远程工作区，手机端远程控制界面也不显示自动化相关内容。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="next-steps">下一步<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
